units.source_text: 把表面在裤腿上擦了擦，拂去沙子一看，才二点十分。

en.t: He rubbed the face of the watch against his trouser leg, brushed away the sand, and saw that it was only two ten.

units.source_text: 他忽然想起刚才看表的时候，也同样是二点十分。

en.t: Suddenly he remembered that when he had looked at his watch a little while before, it had also been two ten.

units.source_text: 顿时，他失去了对速度的自信。

en.t: At once, he lost his confidence in speed.

units.source_text: 用蜗牛的眼睛来看，也许太阳也像棒球那样飞速移动吧。

en.t: Seen through the eyes of a snail, perhaps even the sun moves as fast as a baseball.

units.source_text: 于是，他又拿起铁锹，对准沙壁，重新冲了上去。

en.t: So he picked up the shovel again, aimed at the wall of sand, and charged at it once more.
